text:
alex: Quick question — when API key is valid but X-Redwood-Project header missing, should ingress map to org default or reject? Seen some 403s during key rotation. Example incoming:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
# no X-Redwood-Project header
```

nina: For prod we intended org fallback if api key ties to single org, but if key is project-scoped we should reject. If key is org-scoped and there is a default project we map to it.

kai: Agree. Implementation note: proxy currently uses key->project cache; when cache miss it returns 403. We should change to do a lookup to auth service as a fallback before rejecting. Also we should clarify 401 vs 403 semantics.

jen: Suggest rule: 401 = unauthenticated (invalid/malformed key), 403 = authenticated but not authorized. For missing project header: if key is org-scoped and has a default project, inject that and continue; otherwise 403. Add unit tests and doc.

alex: What about rotation window? If a key was rotated and the old key is removed from cache we saw 200 then sudden 403 after TTL eviction.

deploy-bot: infra:deploy finished for proxy v2.1.3 — includes cache TTL tweak (30s -> 5s) and health checks.

nina: For rotation, plan: keep old keys accepted for 24h at auth service side after rotation (grace period), and make proxy do an on-demand lookup when cache miss happens rather than immediate 403. That will reduce false negatives during rollouts.

kai: Small PR suggestion: in /ingress auth middleware, if header missing and key is org-scoped, inject header `X-Redwood-Project: <org:default>` so downstream services see an explicit project. Also emit an event `missing-project-inferred`.

jen: Add metric `auth.missing_project_inferred` (increment), tag with org_id and key_hash (hashed) — no raw key or PII. Also add a debug-level log for the inference path.

alex: Awesome. I'll open a ticket and a tiny PR to inject header + unit tests. Will update API docs about header precedence and include a short example in the dev guide. Thanks :thumbsup:

nina: +1. Can we also add a short deprecation note in SDKs if they rely on implicit fallback? Encourage explicit X-Redwood-Project to avoid ambiguity.

alex: Will add a dev note and ping SDK owners.

jen: Also: decide error codes for rotation-rejected keys — if auth service says key revoked, return 401 so clients know to re-authenticate.

alex: Good call. Summary: (1) fallback to org default when key is org-scoped, inject header; (2) on cache miss call auth service before 403; (3) keep 24h grace during rotation on auth side; (4) 401 for revoked/invalid keys, 403 for authz failures; (5) add metrics/logs. I'll file the ticket and link PRs.
